description: This file defines a PHP class 'Basic' that implements CAPTCHA functionality for OpenCart. It includes methods for generating CAPTCHA images, validating user input, and managing CAPTCHA tokens within session data.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A controller class managing CAPTCHA generation and validation for OpenCart

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates and returns the CAPTCHA view with a new token

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates user-input CAPTCHA against session-stored value

methods.name: captcha
methods.description: Creates CAPTCHA image with random ellipses and overlays the CAPTCHA text
